svg.title: How the optimiser picks transfers
svg.desc: Three steps. 1: every player gets expected points (for example B.Fernandes 6.4, Tarkowski 5.6, Haaland 5.4). 2: a mixed-integer program picks the best 15-man squad within the FPL rules and budget, once for each number of transfers from 0 to 5. 3: for gameweek 6 with one free transfer, net gains are 0, +2.2, 0.0, -2.4, -5.3 and -8.5 points for 0 to 5 transfers; only 1 transfer clears the +0.5 per transfer bar, so it recommends 1 transfer.

g.text: the budget decides whether he fits.
at most 3 from any one club
